findings.claim: FY2026（截至2026-06-26）10%以上客戶：Cisco 19.9%、NVIDIA 16.3%、Nokia 10.7%、Amazon 10.5%；NVIDIA 占比由FY2024的35.1%、FY2025的27.6%降至16.3%，Cisco由13.4%升至19.9%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 8 Significant customers

findings.claim: 2026-06-26應收帳款集中：Cisco 16.1%、Nokia 14.2%、Amazon 11.5%；NVIDIA 前一年25.5%，本年低於10%。

findings.claim: 公司10-K風險因素揭露：客戶集中增加應收帳款集中與客戶違約風險；許多客戶負債重或財務困難，部分客戶曾倒閉、破產或退出光學市場（為一般性揭露，未點名特定客戶惡化）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Further, our customer concentration increases the concentration of our accounts receivable and our exposure to payment default by any of our key customers. Many of our existing and potential customers have substantial debt burdens, have experienced financial distress or have static or declining revenues

customer_concentration_credit.note: 未另行搜尋大客戶信用評等；僅用一手10-K摘錄。
